title: Pretzels
description: A silly little pack for pretzels
body:
This is a texture pack that I really like because im german, but it changes the texture and model (emf and etf required) of a golden carrot, to a simple lightly salted german pretzel.
To change the food that this changes, simply go into the files until you find a golden_carrot.json, and a golden_carrot.png, and then rename those to the food you like. Most of the time this should work.
